gcp.sql.deletion_protection.summary: Enable deletion protection on the affected Cloud SQL instance after reviewing its lifecycle owner.
steps: Confirm the instance name and project from the finding, and review whether its owner intends to protect it from accidental deletion.
Enable the Cloud SQL instance's deletion protection setting using the approved console or infrastructure configuration workflow.
Read back settings.deletionProtectionEnabled, confirm it is true, then recollect Cloud SQL facts and rerun the check.
caveats: Deletion protection blocks deletion attempts but does not replace backups or control who may change the protection setting.
An intentional deletion later requires an explicit approved change to disable protection first.
